Great, inexpensive little park on our way to Sedona from Albequerque. The owner was super nice. Had a quiet stay and found out some interesting history about Joseph City. pages.lines:
Stay length	Rate	Notes
Daily	$65 – $80	Plus 12.975% AZ tax
Weekly	$325 – $400	Plus 12.975% AZ tax
Monthly	$650 – $800	No tax
Storage	$100	No tax
Site Guarantee Fee
Reservation type	Guarantee fee	Notes
Daily	$25	Non-refundable
Weekly	$50	Non-refundable
Monthly	$75	Non-refundable
Guests & Occupancy
Each site rate covers up to 2 adults (age 13+) and 4 children (under age 13).
Additional guests age 13 and up are $5.00 per person, per day.
Maximum occupancy is 6 guests per site.
One vehicle per site is included. A few larger sites can accommodate a second vehicle with office approval; otherwise, overflow parking is available.
Extra motorized vehicles beyond 2 per site: $5.00 per day.
Tow-behind cargo trailers, storage trailers, and car haulers kept in storage: $5.00 per day.
Commercial vehicles may park only in overflow or storage areas: $100.00 per month.
Payment & Discounts
Cancellation Policy
All reservations include a $25 cancellation fee once confirmed. Beyond that, how much of your payment is refundable depends on how far ahead you cancel:
Length of stay	Cancel with…	What you get back
30+ nights	More than 30 days notice	Full refund, minus the $25 fee
30 days or less notice	No refund
Under 30 nights	14+ days notice	Full refund, minus the $25 fee
Less than 14 days notice	No refund
